## Project Summary

This is a React-based weather application built with:
- React 18 with TypeScript
- Vite as the build tool
- OpenWeatherMap API for weather data
- Modern, responsive CSS with animations

## Key Features
- City search functionality
- Real-time weather display
- Weather details (humidity, wind speed, pressure, visibility)
- Responsive mobile-friendly design
- Loading and error states

## Setup Instructions
1. Run `npm install` to install dependencies
2. Get a free API key from https://openweathermap.org/api
3. Update the API_KEY variable in src/App.tsx
4. Run `npm run dev` to start the development server
